ns2:section.sectionText: Open to undergrads campuswide (including freshmen). Meets with LIS 590BTW. A minimum of two hours per week of approved community service related to children is a requirement of the course. Placements with schools will be made through the course instructor. This section focuses on elementary through middle school. Placements will be at Booker T. Washington Elementary School in Champaign, with other sites added as needed. Students must be able to tutor at least one of following times: Tu, Wed, Th from 3:00-5:00 p.m. See section description at http://lis.illinois.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html
